regulations.name: IEC 60601-1 Medical electrical equipment general requirements for basic safety and essential performance

tests.requirement: Limits for LEAKAGE CURRENT in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION based on 8.7.3 did not exceed
Voltage limits for ACCESSIBLE PARTS including APPLIED PARTS in 8.4.2 did not exceed
ME EQUIPMENT complied with the requirements of 9.1 to 9.8 for specific MECHANICAL HAZARDS
During application of SINGLE FAULT CONDITIONS in 13.2.2-13.2.13, inclusive, NORMAL CONDITIONS in 8.1 a) applied in least favourable combination
ME EQUIPMENT remained safe after tests of 13.2.13.2 to 13.2.13.4 (inclusive), and cooling down to within 3°C of the temperature in the test environment
tests.result: Tests of 13.2.13.2 to 13.2.13.4 do not applied to this equipment

tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT examined for compliance or appropriate tests such as dielectric strength of motor insulation according to 8.8.3 conducted

For insulation of thermoplastic materials relied upon as a MEANS OF PROTECTION (see 8.8), the ball-pressure test specified in 8.8.4.1 a) performed at a temperature 25°C higher than temperature of insulation measured during tests of 13.2.13.2 to 13.2.13.4 (inclusive)

ME EQUIPMENT with heating elements - a1) thermostatically controlled ME EQUIPMENT with heating elements for building-in, or for unattended operation, or with a capacitor not protected by a fuse connected in parallel with THERMOSTAT contacts met tests of 13.2.13.2 b) & 13.2.13.2 c)
a2) ME EQUIPMENT with heating elements RATED for non-CONTINUOUS OPERATION met tests of 13.2.13.2 b) and 13.2.13.2 c)
a3) other ME EQUIPMENT with heating elements met test of 13.2.13.2 b)

温度测试要求（页74）：
- 火焰、熔融金属、有毒或可燃物质的有害量排放未发生（P）
- 外壳变形不影响15.3.1条款合规性未发生（P）
- APPLIED PARTS温度未超过Table 24允许值（按11.1.3测量）（P）
- ME设备非APPLIED PARTS但可能被触碰部件温度未超过Table 23值（按11.1.3测量和调整）（P）
- 可能被触碰但非操作用途的ACCESSIBLE PARTS温度未超过Table 34限值（按11.1.3测量和调整）（P）
- 用于操作ME设备的ACCESSIBLE PARTS温度未超过Table 23限值（P）
- Table 22中'其他元件和材料'允许值×1.5−12.5°C未被超过（P）
- 绕组温度Table 26、27、31限值：无绕组使用（N/A）
- 所有其他情况Table 22未超过（P）
- 温度按11.1.3测量（P）

单一故障条件下火焰/熔融金属排放豁免条款（页74-75）：
SINGLE FAULT CONDITIONS在4.7、8.1 b)、8.7.2和13.2.2中关于火焰、熔融金属或可燃物质排放的要求，不适用于以下部件和组件：
- 供电电路在单一故障条件下1分钟后无法提供15W（N/A）
- 或安装在最低FV1阻燃等级材料上的二次电路（N/A）
- 二次电路在正常条件和单一故障条件下电压低于60Vdc/42.4Vpeak（N/A）
- 二次电路在正常条件和单一故障条件下限制在100VA或6000J以内（N/A）
- 二次电路导线绝缘类型为PVC、TFE、PTFE、FEP、聚氯丁橡胶或聚溴化物（N/A）
- 或电路中元件具有HIGH INTEGRITY CHARACTERISTICS（N/A）
- 或部件和组件完全包含在符合11.3的防火外壳内（通过设计文件审查验证）（N/A）
- 测试后热断路器和过流保护设定值未发生足以影响安全功能的变化（N/A）
